\section{\texttt{OpenAIChatLLM}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.llm.OpenAIChatLLM}\index{Classes!OpenAIChatLLM}

Optional OpenAI-compatible chat provider.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
OpenAIChatLLM(self, api_key: str, model: str, *, base_url: str = 'https://api.openai.com', timeout_seconds: float = 30.0, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{api\_\allowbreak{}key}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{model}] \texttt{str}, required.
  \item[\texttt{base\_\allowbreak{}url}] \texttt{str}, default \texttt{'https:/\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}api.\allowbreak{}openai.\allowbreak{}com'}, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{timeout\_\allowbreak{}seconds}] \texttt{float}, default \texttt{30.\allowbreak{}0}, keyword-only.
  \item[\texttt{transport}] \texttt{httpx.\allowbreak{}BaseTransport \textbar{} None}, default \texttt{None}, keyword-only.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{ValueError}
\apifield{Attributes}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{capabilities}] default \texttt{ProviderCapabilities(supports\_\allowbreak{}streaming=True,\allowbreak{} supports\_\allowbreak{}tool\_\allowbreak{}calling=True,\allowbreak{} supports\_\allowbreak{}json\_\allowbreak{}mode=True,\allowbreak{} max\_\allowbreak{}context\_\allowbreak{}tokens=None)\allowbreak{}}
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}The implementation uses raw HTTP through \texttt{httpx} to keep the dependency tree small. \texttt{base\_\allowbreak{}url} is configurable, so any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenAI, Azure-compatible gateways, vLLM, LiteLLM proxies, ...) works. The deterministic local provider remains the default and is used in CI.
